how: Every symbol another company held before (52, from the vendor's ticker events, tools/history_lake/identity.py) was checked against production's daily series for a price break at the edges of the other company's window. These five serve another company inside a window. GEN (2026-11-18) was found by a census of every universe daily series for price breaks and checked day by day against an independent vendor's per-company series: its earlier holders are delisted, so the events file cannot name them. `source`: the symbol the current company traded as during the window (its bars replace the window's); null: it did not trade yet (the window is dropped). `from` null: everything before `until`. Dates are ET trading dates, `until` exclusive.

GEN.why: GenOn Energy ($3.72 on 2010-12-06 after Symantec's $17.09), then a $64-82 security from 2012-12-17, traded as GEN; the company's own series (Symantec) agrees again from 2013-04-12 ($22.10). Measured 2026-11-18 against an independent vendor's GEN, day by day within 2%
